---
title: "Bacterial Relative Abundance Stacked Area Plots by Sampling Site and Time"
output:
  pdf_document: default
  html_notebook: default
---

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(rprojroot)
library(eoffice)  

# Read the file paths of the data
cap_file <- sprintf("%s/data/merged_abundance_table_YX_Nanning.txt", find_rstudio_root_file())
metadata_file <- sprintf("%s/data/wastewater_sample_metadata_table1.tsv", find_rstudio_root_file())

# Read the second line as column names to preserve original sample names
header_line <- readLines(cap_file, n = 2)[2]  # Read second line
sample_names <- str_split(header_line, "\t", simplify = TRUE)

# Read data, skip the first two lines and use the manually read column names
cap_data <- read.table(cap_file, header = FALSE, skip = 2, col.names = sample_names, check.names = FALSE)
metadata <- read.delim(metadata_file)

# Convert the date to Date type and calculate the week number
metadata$Date <- as.Date(metadata$Date, format = "%Y/%m/%d")
metadata$Week <- as.numeric(format(metadata$Date, "%U")) + as.numeric(format(metadata$Date, "%Y")) * 52

# Function to extract data at different taxonomic levels
extract_level <- function(data, level) {
  level_patterns <- list(
    "phylum" = "p__[^|]+",
    "class" = "c__[^|]+",
    "order" = "o__[^|]+",
    "family" = "f__[^|]+",
    "genus" = "g__[^|]+",
    "species" = "s__[^|]+")
  
  pattern <- level_patterns[[level]]
  if (is.null(pattern)) {
    stop("Invalid taxonomic level specified.")
  }
  
  data %>%
    filter(str_detect(clade_name, pattern) & str_count(clade_name, "\\|") == which(names(level_patterns) == level)) %>%
    mutate(level_name = str_extract(clade_name, pattern)) %>%
    select(-clade_name) %>%
    group_by(level_name) %>%
    summarise_all(sum) %>%
    pivot_longer(-level_name, names_to = "sample", values_to = "abundance")
}

# Extract data for each taxonomic level from the captured group data
levels <- c("phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus", "species")
cap_level_data <- map(levels, ~extract_level(cap_data,.x))

# Function to replace specific taxonomic unit names
replace_bins <- function(data, level) {
  if (level == "class") {
    data$level_name <- ifelse(str_detect(data$level_name, "c__CFGB"), "class-level genome bins", data$level_name)
  } else if (level == "order") {
    data$level_name <- ifelse(str_detect(data$level_name, "o__OFGB"), "order-level genome bins", data$level_name)
  } else if (level == "family") {
    data$level_name <- ifelse(str_detect(data$level_name, "f__FGB"), "family-level genome bins", data$level_name)
  } else if (level == "genus") {
    data$level_name <- ifelse(str_detect(data$level_name, "g__GGB"), "genus-level genome bins", data$level_name)
  } else if (level == "species") {
    data$level_name <- ifelse(str_detect(data$level_name, "s__GGB32253_SGB56808|s__SGB"), "species-level genome bins", data$level_name)
  }
  return(data)
}

# Apply the replacement function to the data at each taxonomic level
cap_level_data <- map2(cap_level_data, levels, replace_bins)

# Function to select the top 10 taxonomic groups by relative abundance and group the rest as "Other"
select_top10_and_group_others <- function(data, level) {
  top10 <- data %>%
    group_by(level_name) %>%
    summarise(total_abundance = sum(abundance)) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_abundance)) %>%
    head(10) %>%
    pull(level_name)
  
  data %>%
    mutate(level_name = ifelse(level_name %in% top10, level_name, paste0("Other ", level, "s"))) %>%
    group_by(sample, level_name) %>%
    summarise(abundance = sum(abundance), .groups = "drop")
}

# Apply the function to select top 10 and group others to the data at each taxonomic level
cap_level_data <- map2(cap_level_data, levels, select_top10_and_group_others)

# Custom color palette
cns_colors <- c("#bdbdbd","#4DBBD5", "#00A087", "#3C5488", "#F39B7F", "#8491B4", "#91D1C2",  "#7E6148", "#B09C85", "#4a1486", "#e8743c","#6a51a3", "#8264CC", "#3C5488B2", "#0072B2", "#4387B5", "#5D90BA", "#56B4E9", "#DC0000","#4DBBD5B2", "#2EBEBE", "#009E73", "#167153", "#4c9568", "#356d67", "#74B346", "#7CC767", "#b0d45d","#E64B35", "#7fb961", "#8EA325", "#A9D179", "#91D1C2B2", "#84CAC0", "#F1CC2F", "#D8D155", "#ffe788", "#ffc556", "#F5AE6B", "#eb998b", "#cca69c", "#BCB8D3", "#8491B4B2", "#9e9ac8", "#737373", "#999999",  "#9ecae1", "#76afda", "#abddff", "#dcf2ff", "#fddbc8","#252525", "#562e3c", "#7A142C", "#d73027", "#E64B35B2",  "#223D6C", "#004529", "#42465c", "#7d4444", "#9e6c69", "#8c510a", "#A14462", "#a14462",  "#bf812d", "#D55E00",  "#E0367A", "#df65b0", "#CC79A7")

# Define sites groups
sentinel_sites <- c("DXL", "HCZ", "RHN", "SLZ", "SY", "ZHGC")
wwtp_sites <- c("JN", "XXJ", "NPJ")

# Plot and save the charts for each taxonomic level and site group
for (level in levels) {
  data <- cap_level_data[[which(levels == level)]]
  
  # Process Sentinel sites
  sentinel_data <- data %>%
    left_join(metadata, by = c("sample" = "sample_ID")) %>%
    filter(Site %in% sentinel_sites & !is.na(Site))
  
  if(nrow(sentinel_data) > 0) {
    all_level_names_sentinel <- sort(unique(sentinel_data$level_name))
    num_levels_sentinel <- length(all_level_names_sentinel)
    if (num_levels_sentinel <= length(cns_colors)) {
      colors_sentinel <- setNames(cns_colors[1:num_levels_sentinel], all_level_names_sentinel)
    } else {
      warning("The number of taxonomic levels exceeds the available colors. Some levels may have duplicate colors.")
      colors_sentinel <- setNames(rep(cns_colors, length.out = num_levels_sentinel), all_level_names_sentinel)
    }
    
    sentinel_plot <- ggplot(sentinel_data, aes(x = Date, y = abundance, fill = level_name)) +
      geom_area(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
      labs(x = "Month", y = "Relative Abundance (%)", 
           title = paste("Bacterial", level, "Abundance by Sentinel Sampling Site")) +
      scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y-%m", date_breaks = "1 month") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = colors_sentinel) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
      theme(
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)
      ) +
      facet_wrap(~ Site, ncol = 6)
    
    # Only show y-axis labels for the leftmost plot
    sentinel_plot <- sentinel_plot + theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
    )
    
    sentinel_plot <- sentinel_plot + theme(
      strip.text.y = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines")
    )
    
    sentinel_plot <- sentinel_plot + theme(
      axis.text.y = if (seq_along(unique(sentinel_data$Site))[1] == 1) {
        element_text(size = 8)
      } else {
        element_blank()
      }
    )
    
    # Save Sentinel sites plot as PDF
    pdf_output_path_sentinel <- sprintf("%s/charts/Sentinel_Bacterial_%s_Abundance.pdf", find_rstudio_root_file(), level)
    ggsave(pdf_output_path_sentinel, sentinel_plot, width = 11, height = 6)
    
    # Save Sentinel sites plot as PPTX
    pptx_output_path_sentinel <- sprintf("%s/charts/Sentinel_Bacterial_%s_Abundance.pptx", find_rstudio_root_file(), level)
    topptx(sentinel_plot, filename = pptx_output_path_sentinel, height = 6, width = 11)
  }
  
  # Process WWTP sites
  wwtp_data <- data %>%
    left_join(metadata, by = c("sample" = "sample_ID")) %>%
    filter(Site %in% wwtp_sites & !is.na(Site))
  
  if(nrow(wwtp_data) > 0) {
    all_level_names_wwtp <- sort(unique(wwtp_data$level_name))
    num_levels_wwtp <- length(all_level_names_wwtp)
    if (num_levels_wwtp <= length(cns_colors)) {
      colors_wwtp <- setNames(cns_colors[1:num_levels_wwtp], all_level_names_wwtp)
    } else {
      warning("The number of taxonomic levels exceeds the available colors. Some levels may have duplicate colors.")
      colors_wwtp <- setNames(rep(cns_colors, length.out = num_levels_wwtp), all_level_names_wwtp)
    }
    
    wwtp_plot <- ggplot(wwtp_data, aes(x = Date, y = abundance, fill = level_name)) +
      geom_area(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
      labs(x = "Month", y = "Relative Abundance (%)", 
           title = paste("Bacterial", level, "Abundance by WWTP Sampling Site")) +
      scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y-%m", date_breaks = "1 month") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = colors_wwtp) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
      theme(
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)
      ) +
      facet_wrap(~ Site, ncol = 3)
    
    # Only show y-axis labels for the leftmost plot
    wwtp_plot <- wwtp_plot + theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
    )
    
    wwtp_plot <- wwtp_plot + theme(
      strip.text.y = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines")
    )
    
    wwtp_plot <- wwtp_plot + theme(
      axis.text.y = if (seq_along(unique(wwtp_data$Site))[1] == 1) {
        element_text(size = 8)
      } else {
        element_blank()
      }
    )
    
    # Save WWTP sites plot as PDF
    pdf_output_path_wwtp <- sprintf("%s/charts/WWTPs_Bacterial_%s_Abundance.pdf", find_rstudio_root_file(), level)
    ggsave(pdf_output_path_wwtp, wwtp_plot, width = 6, height = 7)
    
    # Save WWTP sites plot as PPTX
    pptx_output_path_wwtp <- sprintf("%s/charts/WWTPs_Bacterial_%s_Abundance.pptx", find_rstudio_root_file(), level)
    topptx(wwtp_plot, filename = pptx_output_path_wwtp, height = 6, width = 7)
  }
}
```
